 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 21.04.2023
01.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with G.R. Case No.1645 of 2022 arising out of Badambadi P.S. Case No.375 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C.(City),
Cuttack for offences punishable under sections 341/420/406/294/ 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge,
Cuttack vide order dated 13.03.2023.

// 2 // Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 14.02.2023 and the offences are triable by Magistrate and the cheating amount is Rs.1,70,000/- (rupees one lakh seventy thousand) and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of Vishal Pradhan vs State Of Odisha ....
